conflict_resolutions.EMPTY_CATALOG_NOTE_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH_CU: The catalog note for this order is empty. An empty note is not evidence of continuing effect, of ending, or of anything else; I treated it as no observation and based my view on the held original and other held text only.

material_gaps: No held ACT:, TERM: or ACTOR_TEXT: evidence ending EO 8006 (no own-term expiry in text).
Public Resolution 83 (75th Congress, 52 Stat. 154) and the Joint Committee end date not held.
notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: I read the complete held EO 8006 (3 FR 2680, Nov 14, 1938): orders returns for tax years 1925-1937 open to inspection by the Special Joint Congressional Committee to investigate TVA, for purposes of Public Resolution 83 (75th Congress), under Treasury rules approved that date. It has no own-term expiry and no held ending instrument names it (no ACT:, TERM: or ACTOR_TEXT: record exists). The Committee's authority likely lapsed with its final report but that is statutory context I have not been given a held source for, and past inspection acts are completed rather than ended. No NO basis; YES cannot be shown for a function of a dissolved body either. Blocked pending the joint resolution text and any later Treasury rule.
